unify_header.title: SVP Engineering, Agentic AI Platforms
unify_header.role_narrative: Led the platform roadmap, core systems architecture, and commercialization of a production-grade generative AI Solution Accelerator within a consulting firm, serving Fortune 500 financial institutions and converting bespoke client delivery into reusable IP deployed across enterprise lines of business.

companion_unify_bullets_context.text:
- bul_unify_001: Architected a policy-gated agent execution surface for governed enterprise AI workflows, establishing L0 route-policy dispatch, runtime gate verdict contracts, and proof-bundle lineage across production agentic deployments.
- bul_unify_002: Drove CFO-aligned enterprise adoption motions tied to reusable AI platform commercialization, pairing usage-based forecasting with partner-led deal support to expand recurring revenue.
- bul_unify_003: Delivered audit-grade runtime observability coverage for regulated AI workflows by instituting evaluation gates, telemetry, and rollback controls across the production agentic runtime.
- bul_unify_004: Standardized the AI systems lifecycle from intake through production monitoring, compressing deployment cycle time from six months to three weeks through replayable runtime design.
- bul_unify_005: Architected distributed cloud data runtime integration patterns across Databricks, vector services, and API gateways to support high-availability agentic workloads.
- bul_unify_006: Converted bespoke delivery into reusable platform IP through agentic platform productization, scaling the engineering team from 8 to 28 while advancing the operating model for agentic AI.
